code='''def _flip(a, op):
    if op in (2, 3):
        a = a[::-1]
    if op in (1, 3):
        a = [row[::-1] for row in a]
    return [row[:] for row in a]


def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if g[r][0] != 0 and all(v == g[r][0] for v in g[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if g[0][c] != 0 and all(g[r][c] == g[0][c] for r in range(h))]

    def regions(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i] + 1, bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(bounds) - 1)]

    def regular(ranges):
        from collections import Counter
        counts = Counter(b-a for a,b in ranges)
        size = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [(a,b) for a,b in ranges if b-a == size]

    rs = regular(regions(h, sep_rows))
    cs = regular(regions(w, sep_cols))
    ops = (0, 1, 2, 3)

    def panel(ri, ci):
        r0,r1 = rs[ri]; c0,c1 = cs[ci]
        return [row[c0:c1] for row in g[r0:r1]]

    def object_color(p):
        colors = {v for row in p for v in row if v != 0}
        return next(iter(colors)) if len(colors) == 1 else None

    def shape(p, color):
        return [[1 if v == color else 0 for v in row] for row in p]

    for ri in range(len(rs)-1):
        for ci in range(len(cs)-1):
            ps = [panel(ri,ci), panel(ri,ci+1), panel(ri+1,ci), panel(ri+1,ci+1)]
            colors = [object_color(p) for p in ps]
            for color in set(c for c in colors if c is not None):
                occupied = [i for i,c in enumerate(colors) if c == color]
                if len(occupied) != 3:
                    continue
                missing = next(i for i,c in enumerate(colors) if c is None)
                base = _flip(shape(ps[occupied[0]], color), occupied[0])
                if all(_flip(base, i) == shape(ps[i], color) for i in occupied):
                    expected = _flip(base, missing)
                    r0,r1 = rs[ri + missing//2]
                    c0,c1 = cs[ci + missing%2]
                    for y,row in enumerate(expected):
                        for x,val in enumerate(row):
                            if val:
                                g[r0+y][c0+x] = color
    return g
'''
